name: Convertir tipos
description: Cambia el tipo de las columnas que se leyeron mal, como fechas o números guardados como texto.

impl.template: SELECT *{{#if conversions}} REPLACE ({{#each conversions}}{{#unless @first}}, {{/unless}}{{#if (eq to "number")}}TRY_CAST({{ident column}} AS DOUBLE){{/if}}{{#if (eq to "number-comma")}}TRY_CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST({{ident column}} AS VARCHAR), '.', ''), ',', '.') AS DOUBLE){{/if}}{{#if (eq to "text")}}CAST({{ident column}} AS VARCHAR){{/if}}{{#if (eq to "date-iso")}}TRY_CAST(CAST({{ident column}} AS VARCHAR) AS DATE){{/if}}{{#if (eq to "date-dmy")}}COALESCE(CAST(TRY_STRPTIME(CAST({{ident column}} AS VARCHAR), '%d/%m/%Y') AS DATE), TRY_CAST(CAST({{ident column}} AS VARCHAR) AS DATE)){{/if}}{{#if (eq to "date-mdy")}}COALESCE(CAST(TRY_STRPTIME(CAST({{ident column}} AS VARCHAR), '%m/%d/%Y') AS DATE), TRY_CAST(CAST({{ident column}} AS VARCHAR) AS DATE)){{/if}}{{#if (eq to "datetime")}}TRY_CAST({{ident column}} AS TIMESTAMP){{/if}}{{#if (eq to "bool")}}TRY_CAST({{ident column}} AS BOOLEAN){{/if}} AS {{ident column}}{{/each}}){{/if}} FROM {{in}}
